# {{ site.title }}

> Software Engineer at Google Search, Zurich. PhD from TU Delft (Computer Graphics & Visualisation
> group, 2026), working at the intersection of computer vision and computer graphics
> on 3D deformation, mesh animation and controllable image synthesis with neural
> representations. 

Earlier: M.Sc. with honours in Computer Vision and Image Processing (Erasmus Mundus:
University of Bordeaux, Autonomous University of Madrid, Pázmány Péter Catholic
University), with a Master's thesis at the Visual Computing Group, Harvard University;
B.Sc. with distinction in Human-Computer Interaction, University of Hamburg.
Based in {{ site.person.location }}. Contact: {{ site.email }}.
